name: io.github.patrickpi1312/eu-compliance
title: EU Compliance Tools (pay-per-call, x402)
description: EU compliance tools for agents, pay per call in USDC on Base via x402 - no account, no API key: EU sanctions screening (AML/KYC) against the official EU consolidated list, counterparty due diligence (KYB), EU VAT rules engine with EN 16931 codes for e-invoicing, e-invoice validation (XRechnung/ZUGFeRD/Peppol), VIES VAT ID and IBAN validation. Every result carries a signed, independently verifiable compliance receipt; verifying a receipt is free.
